第一卷 第37章 阿九是太子爷？！-《我养的AI竟是京圈太子爷》

她手里拿了一堆小吃，旁边跟着彭源，看到阿九被一群保安围攻，想也不想，小吃一甩，就奔过来护崽。

人群被一股蛮力扒开了一条缝。一个扎着马尾辫的女孩挤了进来，八爪鱼似的抱在了上官程身上。

“不许动他！”她把脸埋在他胸口，双手死死箍着他的腰，声音又急又凶，“有什么事冲我来！”

保安们也不是法外狂徒，原本就没敢对太子爷下狠手，此刻看到一个娇滴滴的女孩子过来，更是不敢动手了。将人为了一个圈，不知所措。

围观的集团员工也愣住了。所有人都瞪大了眼睛，脸上的表情出奇地一致——这女孩谁啊？她竟然敢抱他们不近女色的太子爷？

更让人震惊的是——太子爷竟然没有把人推开。

他甚至没有躲。他那条空闲的左手，不知什么时候抬了起来，轻轻护在女孩的后腰上，像怕她从自己身上滑下去似的。

动作很小，但落在围观的人眼里，不啻于一颗炸弹在现场引爆。

上官清越突然发现上官程有些紧张，抓他的手出了一层手汗，他趁机挣脱束缚朝车奔去。

“爸！”上官程想追，霖多多还挂在他身上，他迈不开腿。

上官清越跑到了车前才发现，司机正在外面手忙脚乱的擦玻璃。

司机一脸苦相：“董事长，刚刚从天而降一堆小吃，把前窗玻璃全搞糊了，根本看不清路啊！”

上官清越定睛一看，挡风玻璃上糊着一摊黏糊糊的东西——栗子壳、红薯皮、奶茶渍，还有半颗不知道什么水果的残骸，粘在雨刷器上，惨不忍睹，正是刚刚霖多多甩出去的。

“擦什么？！赶紧换辆车！”上官清越烦躁地看了一眼手表，“来不及了！”

老司机“哦”了一声，慌忙把车开回车库换车。

上官程正想趁机再次控制住自己的父亲，却见那辆迈巴赫突然失控般加速向前，然后直直撞断地库档杆，像颗炮弹一样向下冲去。

“砰——！”

十几秒后，一声巨响从地下车库的方向传来，震得整栋大楼的玻璃都在嗡嗡作响。

所有人的目光齐刷刷地转向那个方向。

车库保安跌跌撞撞的跑出来：“董事长的那辆迈巴赫……在地下车库突然失控加速，撞墙了……车头全毁了……”

上官程第一个反应过来——这车果然被动过手脚！有人想害死他父亲！

上官清越也后知后觉的意识到——自己前去收集证据的事怕是已经泄露到任家了，他们想让自己死。

父子俩对视了一眼，都从对方的神情中读懂了些什么，默契的不再争执。

围观的人群里，有人小声议论着什么。集团员工交头接耳，保安们面面相觑，没人知道具体发生了什么，但所有人都知道——出大事了。

霖多多站在原地，手里还抓着上官程的衣角，满脸问号。她的目光在父子俩之间来回转了好几圈，脑子里像有一团毛线，怎么理都理不清。

“这到底，怎么回事？””

She held a bunch of snacks in her hand, followed by Peng Yuan. She saw Ah Jiu being surrounded by a group of security guards. Without thinking, she threw the snacks away and ran over to protect the cub.

The crowd was torn apart by a force of brute force.A girl with a ponytail squeezed in and hugged Shangguan Cheng like an octopus.

"Don't touch him!" She buried her face in his chest, holding his waist tightly with her hands, her voice urgent and fierce, "Come to me if you need anything!"

The security guards were not lawless lunatics. They didn't dare to be cruel to the prince in the first place. Now that they saw a pretty girl coming over, they didn't dare to do anything.Putting people in a circle makes them feel at a loss.

The group employees who were watching were also stunned.Everyone's eyes widened, and the expressions on their faces were surprisingly consistent - who is this girl?How dare she hug their unwomanly prince?

What's even more shocking is that the prince didn't push the person away.

He didn't even hide.His free left hand was raised at some point and gently placed on the girl's lower back, as if to prevent her from slipping off his body.

The movement was small, but in the eyes of onlookers, it was no more than a bomb detonating on the spot.

Shangguan Qingyue suddenly noticed that Shangguan Cheng was a little nervous, and the hand holding him was sweaty. He took the opportunity to break free and ran towards the car.

"Dad!" Shangguan Cheng wanted to chase, but Lin Duoduo was still hanging on him and he couldn't move his legs.

Shangguan Qingyue ran to the car and found that the driver was busy cleaning the glass outside.

The driver had a grimace on his face: "Chairman, a bunch of snacks just fell from the sky, completely confusing the front window, and I can't see the road at all!"

Shangguan Qingyue took a closer look and saw that there was a pool of sticky stuff on the windshield - chestnut shells, sweet potato skins, milk tea stains, and the remains of half an unknown fruit, stuck to the wiper, which was horrible to see. It was exactly what Lin Duoduo had just thrown out.

"What are you wiping?! Hurry up and change the car!" Shangguan Qingyue glanced at his watch irritably, "It's too late!"

The old driver said "Oh" and hurriedly drove the car back to the garage to change the car.

Shangguan Cheng was about to take the opportunity to control his father again, but he saw the Maybach suddenly accelerate forward out of control, then hit the basement gear lever and rushed downwards like a cannonball.

"Bang——!"

Ten seconds later, a loud noise came from the direction of the underground garage, causing the glass of the entire building to buzz.

Everyone's eyes turned in that direction.

The garage security guard stumbled out: "The chairman's Maybach... suddenly lost control and accelerated in the underground garage and hit the wall... the front of the car was completely destroyed..."

Shangguan Cheng was the first to react - this car had indeed been tampered with!Someone wants to kill his father!

Shangguan Qingyue also realized belatedly that the fact that he went to collect evidence had probably been leaked to the Ren family, and they wanted him dead.

The father and son looked at each other, understood something from each other's expressions, and made a tacit agreement not to argue anymore.

In the crowd of onlookers, some people were whispering about something.The group employees whispered to each other and the security guards looked at each other. No one knew exactly what happened, but everyone knew that something big had happened.

Lin Duoduo stood there, still holding the corner of Shangguan Cheng's clothes in his hand, with question marks on his face.Her eyes flicked back and forth between the father and son several times, as if there was a ball of wool in her mind that she couldn't sort out.

"What on earth is going on?"
